member.name: M:VulkEase.VulkEase.GetVersion
member.summary: Get the VulkEase library version.

member.name: M:VulkEase.VulkEase.CreateContext(System.String,System.String[])
member.summary: Create a VulkEase context, initializing the Vulkan 1.4 instance.
member.param: Application name shown in debug tools and driver info. Can be null for a default name.
Optional array of additional instance extension names to enable. Can be null.
member.exception: Thrown if context creation fails due to: VE_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY if allocation failed, or VE_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED if required Vulkan version/extensions unavailable.
member.remarks: The context is the root object for VulkEase. It owns the VkInstance and must outlive all devices created from it. Call DestroyContext() when done, after destroying all child devices.

member.summary: Destroy a VulkEase context and release all associated resources.

member.remarks: All devices created from this context must be destroyed before calling this.
